nodes.label: Linear Issue Tracker Workflow (skills-ui P-S-4)
nodes.rationale: Routes all repo issue tracking to Linear project skills-ui (P-S-4, team S-a-c) via Linear MCP tools rather than gh or markdown files, aligning milestones 0.1.x-0.5.x with ROADMAP.md.

nodes.label: Wayfinder Map Convention
nodes.rationale: Structures milestone decisions as wayfinder:map parent issues with typed child tickets (research, prototype, grilling, task), native blockedBy relations, one ticket per session, and decision gists appended on close.
